title: Tolnaftate
overview: Tolnaftate stops the growth of fungi that cause skin infections, including athlete's foot, jock itch, and ringworm.

sections.Before using tolnaftate,: tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to tolnaftate or any other drugs.tell your doctor and pharmacist what prescription and nonprescription medications, vitamins, nutritional supplements, and herbal products you are taking or plan to take.tell your doctor if you are pregnant, plan to become pregnant, or are breast-feeding. If you become pregnant while using tolnaftate, call your doctor.
sections.Tolnaftate may cause side effects. If yo: skin irritationIf you experience a serious side effect, you or your doctor may send a report to the Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting program online (https://www.fda.gov/Safety/MedWatch) or by phone (1-800-332-1088).
